key.name: split-condition
key.summary: When the menu and the page show side by side
key.description: An AdwBreakpoint condition on the window (adw_breakpoint_condition_parse syntax, e.g. "min-aspect-ratio: 4/3" for landscape, "min-width: 600sp"). While it holds, the menu is on the left and the page on the right; otherwise the menu opens the page full screen, with a back arrow. Empty: never side by side.

key.name: sidebar-width-fraction
key.summary: Menu width, as a fraction of the window
key.description: Side by side, the menu takes this fraction of the window's width, within the minimum and the maximum below.

key.name: sidebar-min-width
key.description: Side by side, the menu is never narrower than this.

key.name: sidebar-max-width
key.description: Side by side, the menu is never wider than this.

key.name: window-min-width
key.description: The window is never made narrower than this.

key.name: slider-slop-px
key.summary: How far a finger moves sideways before a slider follows it (px)
key.description: A slider changes only when a drag that starts on it moves this far sideways, and more sideways than up or down; then it follows the finger from where it was. A tap does not move it, and a drag up or down scrolls the page.

key.name: window-min-height
key.description: The window is never made lower than this.

key.name: fingerprint-press-title
key.description: Shown while an enrolment waits for a touch.

key.name: fingerprint-press-hint
key.default: 'Put your finger on the sensor in the power key, then lift it. Repeat until the circle is full.'
key.summary: Enroll prompt: how to touch the sensor
key.description: Shown under the title while an enrolment waits for a touch.

key.name: fingerprint-no-touch-hint
key.default: 'The sensor didn\'t register a finger. Press the power key with the pad of your finger.'
key.summary: Enroll failure without a single touch: what to do
key.description: Shown when an enrolment ends before the sensor saw a finger.

key.name: updates-poll-s
key.summary: How often Software update refreshes while an update runs (s)
key.description: While the scheduled updates service runs an update, the Software update page asks for its state this often.

key.name: last-page
key.description: The --page name of the menu entry opened last. Side by side, the app opens with it so the page pane is never empty (the menu's first entry when this is empty or no longer in the menu).
